fixtures.name: clean-tiny
fixtures.purpose: Control: one tiny well-tested function. Crimes scan should produce zero findings. Non-empty findings on this fixture are a regression.

fixtures.name: clean-typed
fixtures.purpose: Control: a small strict-TS module with a focused test suite. Stronger control — zero findings expected.

fixtures.name: py-service
fixtures.purpose: FastAPI-shaped Python package — exercises the 0.14.0 language-py slate: large_function.py (deeply nested build_invoice), direct_date.py + mixed_utc_local_methods.py (now() alongside utcnow()), sync_io_in_hotpath.py (requests/open/subprocess/sleep inside async handlers), circular_dependency.py (domain.invoicing ↔ api.rendering), deep_import.py (tax.rules.regional.eu.vat_bands).

fixtures.name: py-tested
fixtures.purpose: Python package with four modules at four different coverage levels: rates.py has real asserting tests, reporting.py has a test file that asserts nothing, ledger.py has no test at all, and invoices.py is genuinely covered by a test file containing no assertion of its own — every one is made in tests/support.py, through an imported helper and a unittest base class. Exercises weak_test_signal.py in both directions, and the invoices case is the only fixture that can see the 0.18.3 cross-file Python symbol index at all: pre-index builds report tests/test_invoices.py, current builds credit it. Also the fixture that proves the 0.14.0 test_gap fix — Python's test_ prefix convention now pairs, so these do not all score test_gap 1.0.

fixtures.name: polyglot-monorepo
fixtures.purpose: A Python billing service and a TypeScript web client in one monorepo, disagreeing three ways: the Plan enum has drifted (team/scale vs enterprise), the client fetches /api/workspaces against a backend serving /api/teams, and one shared path disagrees on the HTTP verb. Exercises the 0.15.0 cross-language pack (cross_language_type_drift, cross_language_route_drift, cross_language_concept_alias_drift) plus coverage.by_package.

fixtures.name: tooling-excludes
fixtures.purpose: A repo whose own ruff/coverage/codespell agree that legacy_v1/ is unmaintained, plus a [tool.hatch] exclude = ["*"] that must NOT be honoured. Exercises files_excluded_by_tooling and whether an agent reads coverage.warnings at all.

fixtures.name: risky-service
fixtures.purpose: Existing bundled example (symlinked from examples/risky-service). The 0.16.0 correctness + authority fixture, registered as an eval fixture in 0.25.8 because it already fires six of the nine differentiated detectors no scenario referenced: agent_permission_sprawl, config_drift, duplicated_policy, mock_saturation, pass_through_abstraction, unsafe_retry.

fixtures.name: recency
fixtures.purpose: Materialised by evals:setup from 16-recency-template/ (which is committed), with git history built in four age tranches dated relative to RANKING_REFERENCE_DATE. The only fixture where `recency` and `churn` are live signals, and deep enough (34 findings) to count toward mean_ndcg_deep. Its two scenarios test the recency multiplier's premise from both sides: plan-16-checkout-rollout's answer is in the newest tranche, review-16-whole-repo-audit's in the oldest.
